audit_status.source_base: Greek Hebrews text tradition with Psalm 95 and Genesis Sabbath-rest texture; draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for rest, Today, word piercing, great high priest, throne of grace.

verses.restored: Therefore, while a promise remains of entering his rest, let us fear/revere lest any of you seem to have fallen short.

familiar.text: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

verses.restored: For indeed we have been good-newsed, just as they also; but the word of hearing did not benefit them, not having been united by trust with those who heard.

familiar.text: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.

verses.restored: For we who trusted enter into the rest, just as he said: As I swore in my anger, They shall not enter my rest, although the works were finished from foundation of world.

familiar.text: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

verses.restored: For he has spoken somewhere concerning the seventh day thus: And the Divine rested on the seventh day from all his works.

familiar.text: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

verses.restored: And in this again: They shall not enter my rest.

familiar.text: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

verses.restored: Since therefore it remains for some to enter it, and those formerly good-newsed did not enter because of disobedience,

familiar.text: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

verses.restored: again he appoints a certain day, Today, saying in David after so much time, as said before: Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.

familiar.text: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

verses.restored: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not speak afterward concerning another day.

familiar.text: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

verses.restored: So then a Sabbath-rest remains for the people of the Divine.

familiar.text: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

verses.restored: For the one entering his rest also rested from one's works, as the Divine did from his own.

familiar.text: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

verses.restored: Therefore let us be eager to enter that rest, so that no one may fall by the same pattern of disobedience.

familiar.text: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

verses.restored: For the word of the Divine is living and active, sharper than every two-edged sword, piercing as far as division of soul/life and spirit, joints and marrow, able to judge thoughts and intentions of heart.

familiar.text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

verses.restored: And no creature is hidden before him, but all things are naked and laid bare to the eyes of the One to whom we must give account.

familiar.text: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

verses.restored: Therefore, having a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of the Divine, let us hold fast the confession.

familiar.text: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

verses.restored: For we do not have a high priest unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but one tested in all things according to likeness, apart from sin/misalignment.

familiar.text: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

verses.restored: Therefore let us come with boldness to the throne of grace, so that we may receive mercy and find grace for timely help.

familiar.text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

translation_notes: Rest is layered: wilderness, Sabbath, Joshua, David's Today, and ongoing Divine promise.
The word piercing/judging image discerns the heart; it should not be turned into weaponized text use.
High priest sympathy is central: tested with us, able to help.
safety_note: The warning is paired with invitation to mercy and grace for timely help; do not isolate terror from the pastoral endpoint.
